data.name: AD METALLUM
data.detailed_description:
Mining was never meant for peace. It was built to crush you.
You are the rebel. The enemy cannot be named. Their walls, forges, and fortresses are designed to control, but you will tear them apart. Every strike, every blast, every collapse reshapes the battlefield. In AD METALLUM , destruction isn’t just chaos: it’s strategy, survival, and revolt.

Key Features

  • Total Destruction as Weaponry: Collapse ceilings, blow out walls, and turn rubble into cover or traps. Every environment reacts to your fury.

  • Weaponized Mining Tools: Drills, seismic charges, plasma cutters, explosives — tools of rebellion become weapons of war.

  • Brutal Single-Player Campaigns: Carve your path through oppressive fortresses, dismantle enemy strongholds, and survive industrial chaos.

  • Explosive Multiplayer Mayhem: Join friends or foes in chaotic battles where every strike, collapse, and explosion reshapes the map.

  • Dynamic Battlefields: Terrain is never static. Cover disappears, paths open, and every decision changes the fight.

  • Industrial Rebellion Atmosphere: Heavy-metal aesthetics, roaring machinery, and gritty soundscapes immerse you in a world of revolt.

  • Resource Scavenging & Upgrades: Salvage rare materials from the wreckage to upgrade gear, craft explosives, and expand your destructive arsenal.

Why AD METALLUM Stands Out

  • Destruction is core gameplay, not just spectacle. Every shot, blast, and collapse has consequences.

  • Experience a fast, visceral, and brutal world, where chaos and rebellion drive every battle.

  • Single-player or multiplayer: fight alone or with friends; the world bends to the rebel’s will.

Rise. Rupture. Revolt.

You are the rebel. You fight not just for survival, but to tear down everything built to control you. AD METALLUM is chaos, destruction, and unyielding rebellion. Will you leave nothing standing?
